en: Black‑and‑white image of a small wooden railway station building labeled "STÄKET". The station has a steep gabled roof, flower boxes hanging under the eaves, and a covered platform with benches. Several people, including what appear to be railway staff, stand or sit along the platform. Railway tracks run in the foreground, and there are trees and a few houses on a slope behind the station. The caption at the lower left reads "STÄKET Järnvägsstationen," and a small serial number "712092" appears in the lower right.
